description: This file is a test script for Git's handling of CRLF (Carriage Return Line Feed) conversions, involving configuration of core.autocrlf and core.safecrlf, applying and reversing patches, and verifying behaviors related to line ending conversions and binary attribute handling.

methods.name: has_cr
methods.description: Checks if a file contains CR (Carriage Return) characters by using 'tr' and 'grep'.

methods.name: munge_cr
methods.description: Adds or removes CR characters in a file in-place based on the specified operation ('append' or 'remove').

methods.name: remove_cr
methods.description: Removes CR characters from input stream and outputs the result.

methods.name: cr_to_Q_no_NL
methods.description: Transforms input by replacing CR characters with 'Q' and removing newlines, used for testing line ending conversions.
